verses.2: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
verses.3: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.5: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.6: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.7: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.13: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
verses.14: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.15: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.16: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.17: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.18: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
